title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
teaser: A warm, comforting gift: four sisters growing up and falling in love through hard times. Can be sent to someone with Payhip's gift option.
bio: American novelist raised in Massachusetts. She drew on her own family of four sisters for Little Women, which became one of the best-loved American novels.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
teaser: A wild, obsessive love story set on the Yorkshire moors. A dramatic gift for a romantic reader.
bio: English novelist and poet from the Yorkshire moors. Wuthering Heights was her only novel, published a year before her early death at thirty.

title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
teaser: The ghostly Christmas classic of Scrooge's redemption. A perfect festive gift.
bio: The great Victorian novelist of London life. A Christmas Carol was written in a few weeks in 1843 and shaped how the world imagines Christmas.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
teaser: Dark, elegant and endlessly quotable. A stylish birthday gift.
bio: Irish poet, playwright and famous wit. Dorian Gray, his only novel, first appeared in a magazine in 1890 and caused a scandal.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
teaser: Parties, money and a doomed love in 1920s New York. A dazzling birthday gift.
bio: American writer who defined the Jazz Age. The Great Gatsby, published in 1925, is often called the great American novel.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
teaser: Pirates, maps and buried treasure. A thrilling birthday gift for any age.
bio: Scottish novelist, poet and traveller. Treasure Island began as a story for his stepson and gave us the pirate adventure as we know it.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
teaser: A passionate, gripping romance. A Valentine's favourite.
bio: English novelist and eldest of the Brontë sisters. Jane Eyre appeared in 1847 under the pen name Currer Bell.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
teaser: Witty matchmaking and misunderstandings in Austen's most playful romance. A lovely Valentine's gift.
bio: English novelist of wit and sharp social observation. Emma, published in 1815, is her portrait of a well-meaning matchmaker.

title: Sense and Sensibility
author: Jane Austen
teaser: Two sisters, one sensible and one passionate, search for love. A Valentine's classic.
bio: English novelist of wit and sharp social observation. Sense and Sensibility, her first published novel, appeared in 1811.

title: Persuasion
author: Jane Austen
teaser: A second chance at love, Austen's most tender story. A Valentine's gift to treasure.
bio: English novelist of wit and sharp social observation. Persuasion, her last completed novel, was published after her death in 1817.
